All four contracts are deployed with msg.sender as initialAdmin so the      deployer can call grantRole during setup.   2. All operational roles (OPERATOR, VERIFIER, PAUSER) are granted to their      designated wallets.   3. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is granted to the designated admin wallet on every      contract.   4. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is renounced from msg.sender on every contract.      After this point the deployer has zero administrative power.   Important: msg.sender never holds OPERATOR_ROLE, VERIFIER_ROLE, or   PAUSER_ROLE; it temporarily holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE only to call   grantRole, not to move any funds. Renounce is the last step. Usage (dry-run, no broadcast):   forge script contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url $RPC_URL Usage (Arc testnet broadcast):   forge script contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol \\     --rpc-url https://rpc.testnet.arc.io \\     --private-key $PRIVATE_KEY \\     --broadcast Required environment variables:   DEPLOY_ADMIN_ADDRESS    - multisig or hardware wallet; receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE   DEPLOY_OPERATOR_ADDRESS - backend hot wallet; receives OPERATOR_ROLE on PayRouter   DEPLOY_VERIFIER_ADDRESS - KYC verifier; receives VERIFIER_ROLE on KycRegistry   DEPLOY_PAUSER_ADDRESS   - receives PAUSER_ROLE on PayRouter and ScheduledPayouts Optional (defaults used if absent):   DEPLOY_USDC_ADDRESS         - USDC ERC-20 (default: Arc canonical)   DEPLOY_PERMIT2_ADDRESS      - Permit2 (default: canonical)   DEPLOY_FEE_WALLET_ADDRESS   - fee wallet (default: DEPLOY_ADMIN_ADDRESS)   DEPLOY_BILLER_ADDRESS       - initial biller (default: DEPLOY_OPERATOR_ADDRESS)   DEPLOY_BILLER_TREASURY      - initial biller treasury (default: DEPLOY_ADMIN_ADDRESS) After deployment, paste the printed VITE_* lines into .env and restart the dev
